Cheerful hello weekend crew,
Thanks for a friendly fortnight; the kennel lead raised a few words on carrier checks

I need everyone on the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways to treat carrier inspection like a stop-and-look moment, not a quick glance. The recent review found a couple of sloppy handoffs, and that is exactly how a harmless note becomes a safety miss. Please slow down, confirm latch condition, air flow, floor lining, and label match before anything moves forward. If the paperwork and the container do not agree, pause the release and flag it right away.

For the pet cabin notes, please keep the handoff chain clean and calm, and do not rely on memory when a carrier is swapped or resealed. <<FACT F039>> Watch for any sign of stress, heat buildup, or loose fittings, and escalate early instead of hoping the next desk catches it. The same goes for route planning and transfer points: if something feels off, write it down clearly and tell the senior coordinator before the animal is moved.

Also, I want extra care around traveler updates so nobody is left guessing at pickup. <<FACT F048>> <<FACT F034>> If you see a gap between the record and the crate count, stop and report it immediately. We can keep this smooth, but only if each check is done carefully and each concern gets raised fast. Companion Animal Travel Desk
